note: Thorvald's arena takes your weapons, armour and runes; only jewellery goes in.
source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Fremennik_Trials — "you cannot bring weapons, armour, runes, or fletching materials" into the arena, while "you can use food, Prayer, god books, and jewellery". Runes are on that list, so no spell can be cast in the arena however little the cast needs, which is what forbidsStyles states: a barehanded caster would otherwise out-damage a barehanded puncher and be recommended. God books and boots of lightness are permitted too and are not modelled: neither carries an offensive stat, so neither can change a DPS answer. "Weapons and armour are not allowed within the arena, though the player can optionally bring a dramen branch and a knife to make a dramen staff once inside", which is the one weapon the trial admits.

options.label: Dramen staff
options.description: <html>Made inside from a branch and a knife, neither of which is a weapon.</html>

note: The Dawnbringer is taken from the skeleton outside Verzik's room.
source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dawnbringer — taken from a skeleton by the entrance to Verzik's throne room and used on her first phase. It has "a built in failsafe where it's destroyed when you attempt to do anything with it outside of Verzik's room", so no bank can hold it and the pool has to supply it.

note: The Gauntlet stores everything you walk in with; this is what the arena makes.
source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Gauntlet — "Players cannot bring any items into the Gauntlet; when entering the minigame, all items currently on the player will be automatically stored for its duration." The pool is what the arena makes: helm, body and legs, and a halberd, bow and staff, each in basic, attuned and perfected, plus the starting sceptre. The crystalline set is the normal Gauntlet's. Every creature in the arena is under the same rule, not the Hunllef alone: the rat, spider, bat, unicorn, scorpion, wolf, bear, dragon and dark beast are all fought with what was made inside. No crystal dagger: the article lists no dagger among them. Weapon and armour tier are separate ladders: the arena's shards are spent on one or the other, so a player is rarely at the same rung in both.
